beforeDefinition: Base commit plus docs/reviews/edge-runtime-before.patch (two preceding reviewed bugfixes); exact template/source hashes below. Same compiler, fixed inputs and dependency installation.

methodology.metric: Per-request local wall time including request construction, stub origin and response drain. Five warm batch means per process; first request is not process cold-start; no production CPU/TTFB/peak memory claim.
methodology.nativeMetric: Native workerd loopback HTTP with independent origin SHA256/HMAC verification; includes Node client, loopback and origin work.
methodology.aliasLimits: Only the benchmark uses maxDiagnostics 10000 and timeoutMs 60000 equally on both sides; production defaults unchanged.
